pose: A dark, imposing iron buoy equipped with a cluster of four curved foghorn trumpets pointing in cardinal directions. A colossal Leedsichthys fish is lazily gliding past, its massive dorsal fin splitting the dark slate blue surface right next to the float.

environmental_details.ground: Choppy, bituminous black and dark grey sea with thick layers of organic marine snow drifting under the surface ripples.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Moody, diffused lighting from an overcast sky that accentuates the heavy weight and dark silhouette of the iron structure.
